name: David J. McClaskey
role: President and Founder, McClaskey Excellence Institute
bio: David McClaskey, for the last 27 years, has been President of the McClaskey Excellence Institute (formerly Pal’s Business Excellence Institute), teaching leaders a proven path to get their products and services 100% right, every time, through extraordinary operations. In a 55-year career as an executive trainer, coach, consultant, and Baldrige expert, he has worked with more than 15,000 leaders. David is one of the few to have helped seven companies win eight Malcolm Baldrige National Quality Awards, the nation’s highest honor for performance excellence. A Fellow of both ASQ and the Institute of Industrial and Systems Engineers, he also holds ASQ’s Lifetime Service Medal. Author of 100% Customer Delight, he is passionate about helping organizations become extraordinary so they delight every customer.
